ancemb: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings

Source: R/ancemb-package.R
ancemb-package.Rd

Provides functions to reconstruct ancestral protein embeddings from extant (tip) embeddings and a phylogenetic tree. Models are fit with pre-compiled Stan models using Brownian Motion or Ornstein-Uhlenbeck evolutionary processes.
